ctx.x: And this was it. But it was a great thing. You know what that band -- financially, you know what those eight pieces cost? But MGM had to pay for it. They were a little sore, but we played a lot of theatres, and Lena got good money for all the theatres that we played, like the Balabay and Katz BMK in Chicago, (inaudible) and all around, but the Capitol Theatre was an MGM house, and she couldn't go in there on a percentage, she had to take a flat salary, and this is rather Catlett teed her off a little bit, what…
$350, and guys got $400 and all like that. This little They piece band, but it costs $3,000, you know? A week.
